notes.title: Small Content Update - 5/23/2024
notes.notes:
Hello there Urban Nightmare Runners!

We want to thank each of you for playing our game and giving us feedback, we genuinely enjoyed reading all the reviews and seeing your fastest times being posted on the community page! For this latest update, we were wanting to have a few updates to both the UI and replay-ability in the game.

Here are the latest updates to the game:

 Updated Player HUD - We wanted to really embrace the Found Footage aspect of the game so we finally added a HUD that would look more like what you would see in a head/body camera. 
 Updated End scene - We polished the ending of the game to better fit with the new UI, communicate more of our story, and tease more to come in the game.
 Added Level Select Screen  - We realized that in order for players to replay levels to get faster times, they would need to replay the entire game from start to finish and that isn't what we wanted for you to have to deal with. So instead we opted to have a level unlocking system that not only unlocks levels you completed but also saves your fastest time so you can go back and replay it again with ease!


Stay tuned for more updates coming soon, and please keep leaving your great feedback! It really helps us to hear directly from our players what you do and don't like about the game.
